shortDescription: Student-run competitive debate team that travels to tournaments in American and British parliamentary styles and welcomes members of any experience level.

longDescription: Established in the fall of 1981, the Harvard College Debating Union (HCDU) is a student-run organization at Harvard College and is Harvard's only internationally competitive debate association. The HCDU consistently ranks as one of the top three debate teams in the country. We were formerly known as the Harvard Speech and Parliamentary Debate Society (HSPDS).
